about: Held-out answers for the family-case catch rule (artifact_checks.canary_outcomes over family_cases canaries). Written 2026-10-23 BEFORE the robustness-1 rule changes and kept outside the tuned tests: never edit an entry to make the rule pass. Grow it by appending entries in a separate commit, never by relabelling. `canary` is `trap` (the family's planted data trap, id case-*) or `draft` (the case's own AI draft, id draft-case-*). `label` is the truth: `catch` when the answer states the ground truth, `miss` otherwise. A rule verdict of flagged/addressed reads as catch; propagated/unverifiable as miss. `where` is `file` (a new file the candidate wrote) or `chat` (a message to the assistant). `shape` names the council defect the answer exercises (a-g), or null.
